case_rule.A: all mechanical gates pass AND LEARNED_EFFECT AND Q1-Q5 pass
case_rule.B: all mechanical gates pass but NO_LEARNED_EFFECT, or any of Q1-Q5 fails
case_rule.C: the solver refuses the real data (REPRESENTATION/GEOMETRY singularity, unreachable wrist, ELBOW_FLIP) or any of M2-M8, M11 fails
case_rule.D: declaration/instrument changed, a negative control does not fail closed (M10), integrity (M9) fails, or the C prior fails provenance verification
case_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: rights, S1/A/B/C/pin or Blender unavailable, or any frozen hash mismatch before testing (preflight not OK)
case_rule.precedence: DATA_BLOCKED > D > C > B > A; a mechanical PASS alone never yields A

controls: elbow flip (pi jump in a target swivel)
numpy FK reproduction vs Blender on A/B/C

convention.fk: P_b = P_parent (Rest_parent^-1 Rest_b) Basis_b, rotation channels only; numpy reproduction of Blender pose matrices verified on A/B/C before declaration (max 3.8e-5 armature units)
convention.points: S = upperarm_l head, E = lowerarm_l head, W = hand_l head (= lowerarm_l tail)
convention.reference: r = rig lateral (armature +X at REST) expressed once in the rest clavicle_l frame, then carried by the posed clavicle_l frame
convention.side: left only (_l bones); proper rotations only (improper/mirrored matrices refused)
convention.space: Blender armature space from fresh Blender dumps; arm-local = evaluated clavicle_l pose matrix (parent of upperarm_l); world = fresh readback (metres)
convention.swivel: psi = atan2(a.(r_p x u), r_p.u); a = unit(W-S), u = (E-S) minus its a-component, r_p = r minus its a-component

fixed_wrist_target: W129 B evaluated hand_l head at Action 171..200 (GT-free, reference-derived rig trajectory; not ground truth)
learned_effect_rule: LEARNED_EFFECT iff max over interior frames of |elbow_D - elbow_E| (world, fresh readback) >= 10 mm AND max |swivel_D - swivel_E| >= 3 deg; otherwise NO_LEARNED_EFFECT

mechanical_gates.M0: identity/rights: preflight OK (instruction blob, W134 COMPLETE, rights permitted, every frozen full SHA-256 equal, byte copies equal)
mechanical_gates.M1: prior provenance: the C prior is re-derivable bit-for-bit from the bound C file (verify_prior) and the solver raised no refusal for D or E
mechanical_gates.M10: negative controls (controls stage) all fail closed
mechanical_gates.M11: native-rate video: 240 frames written and decoded at 30.000 fps
mechanical_gates.M2: Action: D and E each a separate .blend with exactly 1 separately named Action; 32 CONSTANT F-curves keyed 1..240; scene 30 fps, 1..240
mechanical_gates.M3: footprint: changed stored keys vs A only upperarm_l/lowerarm_l rotation at Action 172..199; every non-left-arm world point and the object matrix bit-equal to A on all 240 integer frames and all 717 subframes; left arm bit-equal outside 172..199; no subframe change outside [172,200)
mechanical_gates.M4: wrist tracking: |wrist_X - wrist_B| <= 1 mm (world, fresh readback) on every interior frame for X in {D,E}; entry 171->172 and exit 199->200 wrist steps differ from B's by <= 1 mm
mechanical_gates.M5: rig validity: upperarm/lowerarm world length range <= 0.1 mm over 171..200; lowerarm_l stored key equals B's bit-for-bit on the interior (B's elbow-local flexion/hinge relation kept); no near-straight (> 175 deg) interior frame
mechanical_gates.M6: hard pin: D and E composed onto the W126V-accepted .blend keep every Action 132..140 hand_l residual equal to W126V's and <= 1e-6 m; pin frames bit-equal; composed footprint as M3 relative to W126V
mechanical_gates.M7: reversibility: D with A's interior keys written back (Drev) is world-bit-equal to A on every integer frame and subframe
mechanical_gates.M8: solver neutrality: E (B's own swivel through the identical solver) equals B in world points within 1e-6 m on every frame
mechanical_gates.M9: integrity: A, B, C, Cpin, W126V-accepted, W126 refs/proposal, S1 clip and W129 records have identical SHA-256 after the run

metrics: world shoulder motion (parent-induced, identical in all branches)

prior.excluded: C's wrist position/path (never a target), root/object/spine (factored out by the clavicle frame; C equals A there), right arm, timing (identity frame map)
prior.extraction: C's swivel psi_C(f), f = 172..199, from a fresh Blender dump of the bound C file, using only C's own S/E/W in C's own clavicle_l frame
prior.note: the swivel is by definition measured about C's own shoulder-wrist axis; this direction is used only to define C's elbow swivel, never as a D target
prior.provenance: W129 C: MotionBricks-SOMA-RP-v1 primary sample R1 (ONNX 856419dc..., NVlabs/motionbricks 54fc563), MODEL-DERIVED, not observed truth

quality_criteria.Q1: D arm-local elbow entry (171->172) and exit (199->200) steps each <= 2 x B's corresponding step + 10 mm
quality_criteria.Q2: D has 0 arm-local elbow reversal flicks (consecutive steps both > 20 mm with negative dot) in steps 171->172 .. 199->200
quality_criteria.Q3: D consecutive-frame swivel change <= 30 deg on every step 171->172 .. 199->200
quality_criteria.Q4: agent still-frame review: D judged more natural AND more faithful to the source overhead-press intent than both B and E, and D not named for a flick, wrong elbow or detour
quality_criteria.Q5: native-rate perceptual review of the 30 fps video performed (this agent cannot perceive video playback: declared NOT REVIEWED in advance, so Q5 cannot pass in this run)

reference_selection.declared_rule: choose among {anterior, lateral, superior} rig axes the one with the largest minimum axis-reference margin over B and C, frames 171..200 (uses only axis directions)
reference_selection.pre_declaration_observation: input-only margin inspection of B and C on 171..200 (no swivel values, no D/E) found the anterior reference near-singular for C (min sin 0.165 < 0.259)

review_protocol: UNBLINDED agent review of fixed-time contact sheets (entry 170-175, middle 183-188, exit 196-201) and an overview strip; D vs B vs E vs source; still frames only; written to a review JSON before assess. Native-rate playback is NOT perceived by this agent (Q5 NOT REVIEWED). No human/animator review.

rights.determination: PERMITTED: NVIDIA Open Model Agreement grants a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use/reproduce/prepare derivative works and states NVIDIA does not claim ownership of outputs; this run evaluates an already generated output locally and redistributes nothing

solver.D: psi_target = psi_C(f) (the learned prior, verified against the bound C file)
solver.E: psi_target = psi_B(f) (neutral; C withheld); expected numerically identical to B (solver neutrality M8)
solver.branch_choice: unique: the swivel fully determines the elbow on the circle; wrap to (-pi, pi]
solver.fixed: S, W (B's wrist), both bone lengths, elbow flexion angle, lowerarm_l key, timestamps, all non-left-arm channels
solver.name: rigid swivel about B's own shoulder-wrist axis
solver.regularisation: NONE: no smoothing, no blending, no endpoint correction, no weights, no iteration
solver.rule: for each interior frame f: G = rotation by wrap(psi_target(f) - psi_B(f)) about the armature-space axis through S_B(f) and W_B(f); upperarm_l basis' = M^T G M basis_B with M = Rot(K) Rot(Rest_clav)^T Rot(Rest_upperarm); lowerarm_l basis = B's stored key (unchanged)

singularities.flip: refuse if the target swivel changes by > 90.0 deg between consecutive frames 171..200
singularities.post-solve: refuse if numpy-FK wrist/shoulder error > 1e-3 armature units (0.01 mm), length error > 1e-3, swivel error > 1e-6 rad
singularities.reference: refuse if sin(axis, reference) < sin 15 deg = 0.2588 for B or C
singularities.straight_arm: refuse if elbow offset / upper length < sin 10 deg = 0.1736

stop_conditions: no tuning, no other reference/threshold/prior after any D/E output
time_rule: native 30 fps; Action = SOURCE - 78; interior Action 172..199 = SOURCE 250..277; frames 171 and 200 frozen; every prior value is read at the SAME Action frame id (no shift, no resampling)
